title: From Observation to Explanation: Mechanistic Interpretability of LLM-Generated Code for Principled Repair
abstract: arXiv:2611.28153v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed software development, yet our understanding of how they generate code remains critically underdeveloped. We address this gap by triangulating evidence across three layers. Longitudinally, autonomous agent-attributed code is statistically indistinguishable from human code under a semantic modification definition (HR = 1.019, p = 0.490), yet attracts disproportionately corrective modifications in production (49.1% vs 37.9% human baseline). This finding demands a causal explanation. Empirically, existing benchmarks overestimate LLM capabilities: models that achieve 84 to 89% correctness on synthetic tasks attain only 24 to 35% on real-world class-level code. translated_title: 从观察到解释：面向原则性修复的大语言模型生成代码的机制可解释性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已经彻底改变了软件开发，但我们对它们如何生成代码的理解仍然严重不足。我们通过在三个层面上进行证据三角验证来弥补这一差距。纵向来看，在语义修改定义下，自主智能体生成的代码与人类代码在统计上无法区分（HR = 1.019，p = 0.490），但在生产环境中却吸引了不成比例的修正性修改（49.1% 对比人类基线的 37.9%）。这一发现需要因果层面的解释。实证上，现有基准高估了 LLM 的能力：在合成任务上达到 84% 至 89% 正确率的模型，在真实世界的类级别代码上仅能达到 24% 至 35%。行为上，检测系统揭示了令人困惑的不对称性：GPT-3.5 远比现代模型更容易被检测到（AUC-ROC = 0.96，相差 27 个百分点），尽管现代模型生成的代码结构彼此相似；然而没有任何单一特征能够……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文通过纵向、实证与行为三个层面的证据三角验证，揭示了现有基准高估 LLM 代码生成能力、且 LLM 生成的代码在生产环境中需要不成比例的修正性修改等现象，并从机制可解释性角度为 LLM 生成代码的原则性修复提供了因果解释。
en_tdlr: This paper triangulates evidence across longitudinal, empirical, and behavioral layers—showing that existing benchmarks overestimate LLM coding capabilities and that LLM-generated code attracts disproportionately corrective modifications in production—and provides mechanistic interpretability for principled repair of LLM-generated code.
